svg.title: Detailed architecture
svg.desc: Seven responsibility layers with cross-cutting controls, reference components and unverified extension candidates.

g.text: ARCHITECTURE DETAIL / 10
Responsibilities and contracts, in more detail.
Target design detail. Product candidates do not imply completed integration or verification.
01 / EXPERIENCE
Experience
Business UI / Authoring Studio / API / SDK / Agent / MCP / Operations Console
Operations, decisions, approvals / Definition, development, publishing / Audit and recovery
02 / TRUST
Trust and access
Gateway / Identity / Tenant context / Delegation / Relationship auth / Attribute policy
Routes, limits, trace / OIDC and actor / Tenant isolation / Delegation, expiry, revocation / Deny wins
03 / BUSINESS CORE
Business core
Ontology & Objects — Object ID / Types / Units / Links / Authority / Revision / History
Actions & Workflows — Rules / Functions / Approval / Idempotency / State transitions
AI & Typed Tools — Authorized retrieval and grounded proposals / Model, Parse, Embedding, Guard, Evaluation
04 / EXECUTION
Execution and data
State & UoW — Object + Action + Outbox / History / Revision / Atomic local commit
Events & Automation — Event / Stream / Trigger / Inbox / Worker / Timer / Causality
Writeback & Reconcile — Receipt / UNKNOWN / Retry / Compensation / External transaction
Ingest & Projections — CDC / Pipeline / Transform / Quality / Identity map / Checkpoint / Graph / Text / Vector
05 / CONTRACTS
Connection contracts
PORTS / ADAPTERS
Types / Auth context / Version / Timeout / Cancel / Trace / Typed error / Capability
06 / TECHNOLOGY
Reference and candidates
REFERENCE — Node.js + PostgreSQL / SQL scan ↔ JSONB projection / Synthetic ERP
Reference: State, Action, History, Outbox / Local Identity, Policy, Audit / Recovery Journal
CANDIDATES — OpenMetadata / DataHub / Keycloak / Dex / SPIFFE / OpenFGA / OPA / Cedar
Temporal / Camunda / Kafka / Redpanda / NATS / OpenSearch / Neo4j / JanusGraph
pgvector / Qdrant / Milvus / Iceberg / Trino / MinIO / Distributed SQL / Event Store
MCP / Model gateway / Kubernetes / OpenTelemetry
07 / EXTERNAL
External systems
ERP / CRM / WMS / RDB / CDC / Files / Lakehouse / BI / Models
CROSS-CUTTING CONTROLS
Policy & Audit / Metadata & Lineage / Release & Composition
Verification / Operations / Recovery & Migration
Authority, evidence / Lineage / Schema, policy and rule versions / Conformance / SLO / Recovery
Own the semantics and rules / Each integration requires separate conformance verification.
AIP–OSS / 10
